inputs.text: [excited] Ten feet long — [amazed] like three 4-year-olds lying end to end. Standing up, three feet tall — [curious] as tall as a 4-year-old. And three hundred kilos — [proud] as heavy as 2 donkeys.
[gasps] 2 donkeys, for such a little dino?
[confident] Yep, [pauses] all that weight came from its armor. [amazed] But it had longer legs than its armored cousins.
